```sql
WITH combined_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS "Centre Name",
        "Month",
        NULLIF("Avg Daily Present", 0) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0) * 100 AS "2023 Attendance Rate (%)"
    FROM attendance_2023
    WHERE "Centre" IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi')
    AND "Month" IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS "Centre Name",
        "month",
        NULLIF("average_attendance", 0) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) * 100 AS "2024 Attendance Rate (%)"
    FROM attendance_2024
    WHERE "centre_name" IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi')
    AND "month" IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December')
),

yearly_averages AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre Name",
        AVG(CASE WHEN "Month" IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December') THEN "2023 Attendance Rate (%)" ELSE NULL END) AS "2023 Avg Attendance Rate (%)",
        AVG(CASE WHEN "Month" IN ('January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December') THEN "2024 Attendance Rate (%)" ELSE NULL END) AS "2024 Avg Attendance Rate (%)"
    FROM combined_attendance
    GROUP BY "Centre Name"
)

SELECT
    "Centre Name",
    "2023 Avg Attendance Rate (%)",
    "2024 Avg Attendance Rate (%)"
FROM yearly_averages
ORDER BY "Centre Name";
```
